caption: A tight close-up shows two hands cradling a smooth orange balloon against a blurred gray backdrop. The foreground fingers press against the balloon's lower-left surface while a softer hand supports it from behind. Over time the balloon's rounded silhouette shifts steadily leftward within the frame. Its left edge creeps across the supporting hand and the background. The two foreground fingers keep contact but drift downward along the curved surface, sliding away from the center. A bright specular highlight on the upper-left skin travels slowly down and left as the form shifts. The blurred gray backdrop stays largely unchanged behind the moving hands. The balloon's crown stays cut off by the top edge throughout.
relations: As balloon shifts left, its left edge moves across supporting hand and background.
Foreground fingers maintain contact while drifting downward along curved surface away from center.
Specular highlight travels slowly down-left as balloon silhouette moves leftward.
Balloon crown remains cropped by top edge during leftward shift.
